level.title: Telugu A1+ — Toys, materials and a visit
goals: Name an object, its material and its shape
Describe a simple making process in order
Ask a craftsperson a clear, respectful question

lessons.title: A toy made of wood
lessons.learn: Identify a toy, say what it is made from, and ask who made it.

grammar.title: material with -తో
grammar.explain: Attach -తో to a material to say what something is made with. Place చేసిన before the noun it describes, and ask who made a particular object with ఎవరు?

examples.en: This is a toy made of wood.
The craftsperson carved the shape of a bird.
Who made this toy?

dialogue.en: Who made this bird toy?
Our artisans made it from wood.
Did you carve this shape yourself?
Yes, I first drew the outline.

lessons.title: From carving to colour
lessons.learn: Retell three simple stages of making a toy using a clear sequence.

grammar.title: converbs for linked actions
grammar.pattern: verb stem + -ి, then the next verb
grammar.explain: When the same person performs a sequence of actions, Telugu can link the earlier action with a converb such as చెక్కి or చేసి. Put మొదట and తరువాత near the step they organise.

examples.t: మొదట ఆకారాన్ని చెక్కి, తరువాత ఉపరితలాన్ని మృదువుగా చేస్తారు.
examples.r: Modaṭa ākārānni chekki, taruvāta uparitalānni mṛduvugā chēstāru.
examples.en: First they carve the shape, then smooth the surface.
They paint it after the coating dries.
Finally, they inspect the toy.

mistakes.wrong: మొదట ఆకారాన్ని చెక్కాడు, తరువాత రంగు వేశాడు.
mistakes.right: మొదట ఆకారాన్ని చెక్కి, తరువాత రంగు వేశాడు.
mistakes.why: Use the converb చెక్కి to link two actions by the same subject in this sequence.

dialogue.en: What do they do before painting?
First we smooth the surface.
Do you paint it next?
Yes, after the coating has dried completely.

lessons.title: Ask a craftsperson about a toy
lessons.learn: Ask a respectful question about a toy's size and price and respond to the answer.

grammar.title: question words and respectful request
grammar.explain: Ask for a price with ధర ఎంత? and for height with ఎంత ఎత్తు? A respectful request can use చూపించగలరా?; keep the question word with the information being requested.

examples.en: What is the price of this toy?
How tall is the elephant toy?
Could you show it a little closer?

mistakes.why: Ask directly with the natural price frame ధర ఎంత?

dialogue.en: What is the price of this elephant toy?
The small one is five hundred rupees.
Could you show me the larger toy?
Certainly, here it is.

lessons.title: Describe a toy's shape and colour
lessons.learn: Give two visible details about a toy so another visitor can identify it.

grammar.title: adjectives before nouns and location
grammar.explain: Place a colour adjective before the noun. Use ఎడమవైపు and కుడివైపు to locate an item in a display, and keep the main predicate at the end.

examples.t: నీలం రంగు పక్షి బొమ్మ ఎడమవైపు ఉంది.
examples.r: Nīlaṁ raṅgu pakṣi bomma eḍamavaipu undi.
examples.en: The blue bird toy is on the left.
The red elephant is in the middle.
The shapes of those two toys are different.

mistakes.why: Keep the colour phrase together before the noun: నీలం రంగు బొమ్మ.

dialogue.en: Where is the bird toy?
The blue bird is on the left.
Is there a red elephant too?
Yes, it is in the middle.

lessons.title: Compare two figures

grammar.title: comparison with కంటే
grammar.explain: Attach -కంటే to the item used as the comparison point. Use పెద్దది or చిన్నది for size; use రెండూ when you mean both items share a feature.

examples.en: This toy is larger than that toy.

mistakes.why: Compare two toys with the adjective పెద్దది; avoid an unnecessary adverb ending here.

grammar.title: future time and polite invitation
grammar.explain: Use వచ్చే with a coming day or event. A respectful imperative రండి is a warm invitation; వస్తారా? asks whether the person can come.

items.q: Say: This toy is made of wood.
Ask respectfully: Could you show the larger toy?
Say: First carve the shape, then paint it.
items.answer: మొదట ఆకారాన్ని చెక్కి, తరువాత రంగు వేస్తారు.

items.q: Which suffix marks the material in చెక్కతో?
Ask: Who made this bird toy?
What does చూపించగలరా? make the request?
They smooth the surface before painting it.
items.answer: రంగు వేయడానికి ముందు ఉపరితలాన్ని మృదువుగా చేస్తారు.

items.q: Please wrap the bird toy in paper.
Which question asks for a toy's price?

culture.text: Kondapalli Toys are a wooden craft associated with Kondapalli in Andhra Pradesh's NTR district. The district administration describes a process in which artisans carve softwood, smooth the figure with a sawdust-and-tamarind-seed-paste coating, then paint it. The subjects include village scenes and animals. Naming the stages of a craft is useful beginner language: మొదట (first), తరువాత (then), చివరికి (finally). The description belongs to this craft tradition, not to every wooden toy.

reading.text: కొండపల్లి బొమ్మల పనిని చూడటానికి నిఖిల్ తన స్నేహితురాలితో వెళ్లాడు. కార్మికుడు ఒక చెక్క ముక్కను తీసుకొని, చిన్న పక్షి ఆకారంలో చెక్కాడు. తరువాత ఉపరితలాన్ని మృదువుగా చేసి రంగు వేశాడు. నిఖిల్ ఒక చిన్న బొమ్మను చూపించి, దాని ధర అడిగాడు. అతని స్నేహితురాలు బొమ్మను జాగ్రత్తగా కాగితంలో చుట్టింది.
reading.gloss: Nikhil went with his friend to see Kondapalli toy-making. The craftsperson took a piece of wood and carved it into the shape of a small bird. Then the surface was smoothed and painted. Nikhil pointed to a small toy and asked its price. His friend carefully wrapped the toy in paper.

listening.script:
నిఖిల్: ఈ పక్షి బొమ్మ చెక్కతో చేశారా?
కార్మికుడు: అవును, ముందు ఆకారం చెక్కుతాం.
నిఖిల్: తరువాత రంగు వేస్తారా?
కార్మికుడు: అవును, ఆరిన తర్వాత రంగు వేస్తాం.
listening.gloss: Nikhil: Is this bird toy made of wood? Craftsperson: Yes, first we carve the shape. Nikhil: Do you paint it next? Craftsperson: Yes, after it dries, we paint it.

mistakes.wrong: మొదట రంగు వేసి, తరువాత ఆకారం చెక్కుతారు.

mistakes.why: Put the making stages in their intended order; the converb చెక్కి links the first action to the next.
